title: Blog
description: I added a [blog](/blog) to the site. This will be used to share game design notes, work in progress, crafting instructions, and battle reports.

title: 2nd Edition is LIVE!
description:
The biggest update since launch is here! Measurements are now standard inches, PvE has its own dedicated book with procedurally generated missions and campaigns, and a lot of the table friction is gone.

[Grab the new rules](/rules) and pick up where you left off.
